_comment: Facts about the SkyPilot image pinned by releases/superplane.lock.yaml, recorded from
the Docker registry so the regression tests that depend on them stay OFFLINE.
These are not assumptions. Each was fetched and hashed: the image index body hashes to
image_index_digest (which is the digest the lock pins, so the lock and this file are
verified against each other), the amd64 manifest body hashes to amd64_manifest_digest,
and the config blob body hashes to config_blob_digest. `config` is that blob's
`.config` object verbatim.
`etc_passwd_uids` and `home_entries` come from extracting EVERY layer of the amd64
manifest and reading the last /etc/passwd to win (layer 5), plus scanning all layers
for any path under home/. There is no uid 1000 and no /home entry, which is why the
Deployment must set HOME explicitly — see test_skypilot_startup_contract.py.
TO RE-VERIFY (needs network; the tests do not):
TOK=$(curl -s 'https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:berkeleyskypilot/skypilot:pull' | jq -r .token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json' \
https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/berkeleyskypilot/skypilot/manifests/<image_index_digest> | sha256sum
The printed hash must equal image_index_digest's hex. Repeat for the manifest and blob.
Read from the skypilot==0.12.0 wheel — the same version the image installs — so the
manifest's command/args/env are checked against the code that will run, not against
an upstream doc or a controller-side constant.
TO RE-VERIFY: pip download skypilot==0.12.0 --no-deps, unzip, and grep the cited
files. Each value below names its source path.
